Project Overview
ChronoSentiment is a deterministic financial simulation platform for evaluating trading strategy execution behavior under realistic market conditions. It consists of a React UI (`my-chrono-sentiment-ui`), a Streamlit-based `app.py` (NOT Flask), Python scripts for data management, a Rust `cs-ingest` binary, and a static Observatory dashboard.

## Completed Work
1. Listed all documentation files in `docs/` directory
2. Read `docs/UI_SPEC.md` — defines 4 tabs, API endpoints, design system, component hierarchy
3. Read `docs/COMPONENT_SPEC.md` — defines props, state, and behavior for all React components
4. Read `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` — defines system components, data flow, directory structure
5. Read `docs/PRD_v3_3.md` — product requirements, simulation-first philosophy, 4-phase roadmap
6. Read `docs/MVP_Scope_Document_v2_1.md` — MVP scope: execution realism, determinism, explainability
7. Read `docs/frontend_cleanup_strategy.md` — frontend direction: 4 surfaces (Observatory, Replay, Trade Inspector, Research)
8. Read `docs/SRS_v1_6.md` — software requirements spec: event-driven deterministic state machine
9. Read `docs/ui/uiux.md` — brief UI/UX spec stub (dashboard, explainability)
10. Read all UI component source files: `App.js`, `RunGA.js`, `StrategyInspector.js` (partial), `GlobalRanking.js`, `CompareStrategies.js`, `StrategyColumn.js`, `ComparisonPanels.js`, `NarrativeBlock.js`
11. Read `app.py` — confirmed it is a **Streamlit** app (not Flask), ~5455 lines, implements live diagnostics dashboard with paper trading simulation, alpha validation, lane health monitoring, phase-space analysis
12. Read `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/index.css` — light theme CSS (NOT dark theme as docs specify)
13. Read `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/App.js` — full content confirmed: left-rail nav, IST clock, operational awareness strip, 4 tabs
14. Read `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/RunGA.js` — full content confirmed: 4 params (population, generations, mutation, seed), hits `http://localhost:8000/run_ga` and `http://localhost:8000/signals/latest`, shows execution verdict + signals topology
15. Read `docs/Backend_Architecture_Blueprint.md` — deep philosophical/architectural doc: event-sourced, deterministic, sequencer-based, simulation kernel
16. Read `docs/Event_Flow_Specification.md` — v2.0 canonical event flow: Intent→Delay→Competition→Position→Interaction→Execution→Outcome, WebSocket streaming, UI as observer only
17. **Generated `DISCREPANCY_REPORT.md`** — comprehensive 17-section report covering all divergences between docs and implementation
18. **Appended sections 16–17 to `DISCREPANCY_REPORT.md`** — added Summary Statistics table (93+ total discrepancies) and Priority Remediation Recommendations (15 items across Critical/High/Medium/Low tiers)

## Key Technical Decisions
- React 18 frontend with custom `cs-*` CSS design system and CSS variables
- **ACTUAL theme is LIGHT** (index.css uses `--bg: #ECEFF3`, `--card: #F7F8FA`) — docs specify dark theme. This is a divergence.
- IBM Plex Sans + IBM Plex Mono fonts (actual) vs unspecified fonts (docs)
- **app.py is Streamlit**, not Flask REST API as docs describe
- Rust `cs-ingest` binary for high-performance candle ingestion
- Deterministic simulation: same inputs always produce same outputs
- Event-driven architecture: all state changes triggered by discrete events
- Event log as single source of truth (not derived state)
- Simulation kernel as single sequencer/ordering authority
- WebSocket streaming from kernel to UI (per spec, not yet confirmed in implementation)
- UI is observer-only — does not compute reality (violated in actual implementation)

## Relevant Files & Code

### Documentation
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` — system overview, directory structure, data flow
- `docs/UI_SPEC.md` — tab specs, API endpoints, design system, component hierarchy
- `docs/COMPONENT_SPEC.md` — component props, state, behavior specs
- `docs/PRD_v3_3.md` — product requirements v3.3
- `docs/MVP_Scope_Document_v2_1.md` — MVP scope v2.1
- `docs/frontend_cleanup_strategy.md` — frontend architecture direction (4 surfaces)
- `docs/SRS_v1_6.md` — software requirements spec v1.6
- `docs/ui/uiux.md` — brief UX spec stub
- `docs/Backend_Architecture_Blueprint.md` — deep architectural philosophy, event-sourced system design (~2268 lines)
- `docs/Event_Flow_Specification.md` — v2.0 canonical event flow spec (643 lines)
- Other docs not yet read: `CANDLE_SUBSTRATE_SPEC.md`, `COHORT_MANAGEMENT.md`, `DEPLOYMENT.md`, `ECOLOGY_COMPARISON_PROTOCOL.md`, `EXECUTION_ECOLOGY_SPEC.md`, `LIVE_SESSION_SPEC.md`, `OBSERVATORY_SPEC.md`, `REPLAY_CERTIFICATION_SPEC.md`, `STORAGE_GOVERNANCE_SPEC.md`, `SYMBOL_HEALTH_SPEC.md`

### UI Components (Actual Implementation)
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/App.js` — 4 tabs via left-rail nav (not top tabs as spec says). Has IST clock, operational awareness strip (hardcoded values), `selectedStrategyId`/`selectedSeed` state for cross-tab navigation. Passes `strategyId`, `seed`, `strategyId2`, `seed2` to StrategyInspector.
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/index.css` — **LIGHT theme** (bg: #ECEFF3). Uses IBM Plex fonts. Border-radius variables all set to 0px (flat design). `--grn` and `--blu` are both `#4F6BFF` (identical, both blue).
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/RunGA.js` — Only 4 params (population, generations, mutation, seed) — **params collected but never sent to API**. Hits `http://localhost:8000/run_ga` (GET, no params). Also hits `/signals/latest` and `/ga/strategy-store`. Shows divergence badges (Overfit/Hidden Gem/Aligned) and signals topology.
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/GlobalRanking.js` — Hits `http://localhost:8000/ga/global-ranking`, shows avg/std/execution_fitness/ga_fitness/classification columns. No filter controls. Classification: stable=green, volatile=amber, fragile=red.
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/CompareStrategies.js` — Accepts comma-separated strategy IDs + seed param. POST to `/compare_strategies`. Uses `parseStrategyParamsFromId` utility. Shows **hardcoded mock data** for structural comparison and replay cert status strings.
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/StrategyColumn.js` — 13 props. Shows execution narrative stream, causal chain panel, raw events JSON dump. Has `showRawEvents` toggle.
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/ComparisonPanels.js` — Shows execution summary comparison, auto-generated insights text, final verdict alert, divergence analysis. All verdict/confidence computed client-side.
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/NarrativeBlock.js` — Renders individual event blocks with group label, narrative text, parent derivation arrow, divergence marker, causal arrows. Block groups: Intent/Queue Entry/Queue Progression/Execution/Other.

### Backend
- `app.py` — **Streamlit** application (~5455 lines), NOT a Flask REST API. Runs on port 8501 (not 8000). Implements: live experiment registry, engine diagnostics, paper trade simulation, alpha validation, alpha climate telemetry, lane health monitoring, phase-space trajectories. Reads from `data/experiments.jsonl`, `analysis/` log directories. Entirely separate product from what the React UI expects.

### Generated Artifacts
- `DISCREPANCY_REPORT.md` — 17-section comprehensive report (93+ total discrepancies identified). Sections cover: navigation architecture mismatch, API endpoint mismatches, per-component divergences (RunGA, GlobalRanking, CompareStrategies, StrategyInspector, StrategyColumn, ComparisonPanels, NarrativeBlock, App.js shell, CSS design system), backend identity mismatch, missing documented features (12 items), undocumented features present in UI (18 items), architectural principle violations (7 items), summary statistics table, and 15 prioritized remediation recommendations (Critical/High/Medium/Low tiers).

## Current Status
**All tasks complete.** The discrepancy report (`DISCREPANCY_REPORT.md`) has been fully written to the project root, including the appended sections 16–17 with summary statistics and remediation recommendations. Key findings:
- The React UI connects to `http://localhost:8000` but no such server exists in the repo (`app.py` is Streamlit on port 8501)
- All API URLs are hardcoded absolute URLs
- GA parameters are collected in the form but never sent to the API
- Client-side business logic (narrative generation, verdict computation, divergence detection) violates the "UI is observer only" architectural principle
- The UI has a light theme; docs specify dark theme
- The actual 4 tabs (Run GA, Inspect Strategy, Compare Strategies, Global Ranking) don't match the documented surfaces (Observatory, Replay, Trade Inspector, Research, Settings)
- Several structural comparison values and system status strings are hardcoded mock data
- 93+ total discrepancies identified across 17 categories

## Pending Tasks
- None — all 5 tasks completed:
  1. ✅ Review project structure and architecture
  2. ✅ Collect all .md files and documentation
  3. ✅ Read all UI components
  4. ✅ Cross-reference docs vs UI implementation
  5. ✅ Generate discrepancy report (`DISCREPANCY_REPORT.md`)
